steps.content: <size=42><color=#7683a2>[DISMYTH] [Chat Room]</color> [Has anyone seen the strange shadows in the fog?]</size>
<color=#fb9259>Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]</color>: Have you guys heard? Sloane Street's covered in fog again.

<color=#fb9259>Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]</color>: Normal? Ha, absolutely not. There's so little rain in DisCity. Why would there be fog? Unless...



<color=#fb9259>Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]</color>: Yes, <color=#fb9259>"that"</color> must be it. The long-lost antagonist of that urban legend is back...
<size=40>...<color=#fb9259>The Mad Shears of the Foggy Night</color> is coming to hunt again...</size>
A maze of dark alleys... Tonight's prey is running, desperately trying to flee the rolling fog creeping up from behind, and the terrifying voice ringing out from within...
Snap... snap...

The sound of footsteps... no, the sound of snapping shears... echoes from the depths of the fog.



No matter where the prey flees, it follows like a shadow, snapping rhythmically as it closes in on the prey.
If at this moment, you dare to turn your head, and peek at the true face of that ghastly shadow...
The man being chased suddenly looks back, yet what can he see in the thick fog?
steps.female_content: The woman being chased suddenly looks back, yet what can she see in the thick fog?

steps.content: Interference noises keep crackling from the comms device in his hand. He can vaguely hear a woman calling for him, but he doesn't dare answer. Panting heavily, he remains on high alert.
steps.female_content: Interference noises keep crackling from the comms device in her hand. She can vaguely hear a woman calling her, but she doesn't dare answer. Panting heavily, she remains on high alert.

steps.content: The sound of snapping shears can still be heard. That "person" is still nearby. Can't stop, keep running! Hurry! Must escape from here.

How can it be seen? It's <color=#fb9259>Mad Shears</color>, after all.



No one knows who it is, what it is, why it attacks, or what strange powers it has.

Mad Shears has been unleashing attacks in Eastside for several years now. Even after being followed and tracked for so long, no clues were ever found.
...Then, why is it that no one can find clues about Mad Shears?
The fog is still all around, but suddenly, the heavy chimes of a clock tower echo through the misty depths, reaching that poor wretch's ears. He's almost at the edge of the fog. He's saved!
steps.female_content: The fog is still all around, but suddenly, the heavy chimes of a clock tower echo through the misty depths, reaching that poor wretch's ears. She's almost at the edge of the fog. She's saved!

steps.content: The runner takes a deep breath and tries to make a last sprint.
But it's too late.
Of course, it can't be found because...
The fog envelops the poor escapee. Something presses intimately against his back.
steps.female_content: The fog envelops the poor escapee. Something presses intimately against her back.

steps.content:
<size=38>Everyone <color=#fb9259>it</color> targets...</size>

<size=40>Everyone who targets <color=#fb9259>it</color>...</size>



Yes, myself included...
The man whips out a gun, but before he can aim it, the barrel gets sliced off.
steps.female_content: The woman whips out a gun, but before she can aim it, the barrel gets sliced off.

steps.content: <size=44>Our **** have all been cut out by <color=#fb9259>Mad Shears</color>...</size>
The hunter is within reach. Yet what the prey sees first is a long, cold blade swinging forth, accompanied by an icy, murderous grin...
... It's not time to surrender yet!

steps.speaker: Serious Woman
steps.content: Chief!!!
In a split second, the spike of red light is sliced apart. His brain hums as if he had suffered a blunt blow to his head...
steps.female_content: In a split second, the spike of red light is sliced apart. Her brain hums as if she had suffered a blunt blow to her head...

<color=#7683a2>Bahamut 1218</color>: What happened next? 0□0

<color=#7683a2>T04dRati0s</color>: Every few years, some fool pops up to say there's fog somewhere and that Mad Shears is coming...

<color=#7683a2>T04dRati0s</color>: Is Mad Shears a travel blogger now? Hitting all the hot spots around town?

<color=#7683a2>T04dRati0s</color>: Some stupid urban legend fan is spinning an old tale for attention again.

<color=#fb9259>Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]</color>: <size=44>Spinning your dumbass!</size> There's been fog on Sloane Street recently. Go check the weather forecast if you don’t believe me!

<color=#7683a2>T04dRati0s</color>: The idiot OP is back. Report and ban ASAP, please.

Bahamut 1218: I just saw the warning notice. The FAC is indeed saying that it's fogging up somewhere in Eastside, and that everyone should steer clear of that area. Bahamut 1218: I checked the coordinates. It's indeed Sloane Street... Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]: Exactly! It's Mad Shears! Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]: "Roaming in the misty alley to harvest your soul"... Legend of the foggy night! Doesn't it sound cool?

<color=#7683a2>T04dRati0s</color>: It's just fog from the <color=#fb9259>blue rain</color>. The FAC's manmade rain is bad news for everyone. Y'all should be used to it by now.

<color=#7683a2>T04dRati0s</color>: It was bad enough they did that in West District, but now in Eastside, too...
T04dRati0s: Ha, if they can make a killer fog outta this sand pit, that'll be a real urban legend. Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]: Ooooh a new urban legend!! Bring it on!! T04dRati0s: Bring on my ass...

<color=#7683a2>T04dRati0s</color>: All right, break it up. The censors are going crazy lately. If you keep saying that, the forum will be deleted.



<color=#7683a2>T04dRati0s</color>: Gnight everyone.
The impact severely impairs your consciousness. Amidst the chaos, you're spurred on only by raw instinct. You struggle and try to crawl out of the fog and dark alley with all your might.
But all the strength in your body disappears alongside the shackles in your palms, and your vision gradually blurs.
Who is that...
You don't even have the strength to lift up your head. You can barely make out the voice of the person who came. All signals you pick up are immediately shattered by your collapsing consciousness.
...What... happened to you...
You open your mouth to say something, but forget what you're saying. As that person leans toward you...
Your last bit of consciousness gets swallowed up by the fog.

█ Number: FAC-M-122-I

█ File: Eastside Contamination Monitoring Log

*Entry I:

The M-value of DisCity began to fluctuate once more, and Mania incidents reappeared. To fight the contamination, the City Council passed a motion to activate rainmaking machines that produce blue rain.

While the city's M-value was brought under control, <color=#fb9259>strange fog</color> began to appear in various parts of the city.
All 26 cases of fog occurred at night, and each did not exceed three hours.

*Entry II:
 
The thick fog might be a side effect of blue rain purification, but it might also be from an unidentified Mania incident.
The FAC has dispatched an inspector to Sloane Street to investigate.
*Annex V — Incident Aftermath:

On the day of the investigation, Sloane Street was once again overtaken by dense fog. Rescue efforts failed and the mission was aborted.

<color=#fb9259>Contact was lost, and the inspector's whereabouts remain unknown.</color>
